title: Tiny Wound Seg Smoke Test
subtitle: 3-image dataset with exact baseline-outputs structure for ablation testing
description:
Minimal dataset (3 test + 3 train images) replicating exact baseline-outputs structure.

**Purpose**: Smoke testing for ablation notebooks to catch path/extension bugs before GPU runs.

**Structure**:
```
data_wound_seg/
├── train/
│   ├── images/    (3 PNG)
│   ├── masks/     (2 PNG) 
│   └── labels/    (2 TXT YOLO format)
└── test/
    ├── images/    (3 PNG)
    ├── masks/     (3 PNG for evaluation)
    └── labels/    (3 TXT YOLO format for training)
```

**Key Features**:
- OK Exact same directory structure as baseline-outputs
- OK Both YOLO .txt labels AND PNG masks in test/ (validates proper usage)
- OK Fast validation (<30 seconds runtime)
- OK Catches path, extension, and evaluation code bugs

**Usage**: Replace `baseline-outputs` dataset with this in ablation notebooks for smoke testing.
